messages.author: iris.farrow.100371@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the Wisconsin Chapter space. We will use this room to coordinate local tastings and chapter meet-ups ahead of the spring conference.

messages.author: dirk.carlsen.100834@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Thanks Leonor. I have put together the roster for the upcoming dairy tour around Madison if anyone wants to join us next month.

messages.author: hector.guerrero.100463@emberleafinecheese.example
messages.text: In light of the recent health advisories, all of our spring chapter gatherings are on hold until further notice. Stay safe everyone.

messages.author: elena.chowdhury.101043@quillpost.example
messages.text: ICF staff is setting up the virtual training modules now so our members can complete their credential renewals online this year.

messages.author: obi.kone.100216@birchmoorcreamery.example
messages.text: The online food safety sessions have been quite useful, though we are all looking forward to seeing each other in person again soon.

messages.author: iris.farrow.100371@bluebarn.example
messages.text: In-person meetings are officially back on the calendar. We are meeting at the community hall in Madison next Tuesday to plan the fall competition.

messages.author: hector.guerrero.100463@emberleafinecheese.example
messages.text: Competition entries this year exceeded our previous venue capacity by a wide margin. We will need a bigger hall next season.

messages.author: dirk.carlsen.100834@mailhaven.example
messages.text: The artisan boom is keeping all our creameries operating at full capacity. We are currently booking extra milk tankers just to keep up with demand.

messages.author: amelia.marsh.101254@rimefieldcheesemaking.example
messages.text: Sales are strong across the board, but finding experienced packaging staff remains our biggest bottleneck right now.

messages.author: iris.farrow.100371@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Sponsorship commitments for our annual autumn showcase are locked in, and the events team has finalized the catering contracts.

messages.author: hector.guerrero.100463@emberleafinecheese.example
messages.text: Our aging cellars are completely full. We are having to turn down custom orders for the holiday season.

messages.author: dirk.carlsen.100834@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Cost inflation on packaging and cultures is starting to squeeze margins. If any small maker needs hardship dues information, let me know.

messages.author: iveta.dahl.101420@lakemail.example
messages.text: We are navigating some tough succession talks at our dairy this summer, but the ICF guidance documents have been a great help.

messages.author: iris.farrow.100371@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Costs have finally begun to stabilize across the region, which is a relief for our smaller affineurs.

messages.author: ravi.marsh.102416@lakemail.example
messages.text: The new raw-milk aging rule modernizations are moving through the committee phase. We are organizing a briefing session for next month.

messages.author: dirk.carlsen.100834@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Traceability standards are tightening up as well. We are updating our lot tracking software to align with the new federation guidelines.

messages.author: hector.guerrero.100463@emberleafinecheese.example
messages.text: Next-generation makers are stepping up nicely into management roles at several local plants, bringing some fresh energy to our chapter.

messages.author: iris.farrow.100371@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Thanks to everyone who contributed to this year's regional review. I will post the agenda for our late autumn gathering shortly.
